summary: The Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K to report the pricing of SGD 350 million of Fixed Rate Reset Callable Subordinated Notes (NVCC) — a routine debt issuance. The notes bear 3.125% fixed semi-annual interest through August 5, 2031, then reset to 5-year SORA-OIS plus 1.048% until maturity on August 5, 2036. The Bank may redeem them on the reset date at par with OSFI approval. Net proceeds are for general corporate purposes, possibly to redeem outstanding capital securities or repay liabilities. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary capital management transaction.
